item.title: Injured Rider Update - Stephen Cummins (Grafton, Tuesday)
item.description: Jockey Stephen Cummins sustained an injury to his left wrist after his mount (Sarmat) became fractious in the barriers prior to it being a late scratching at Grafton today. Stephen will require a more thorough medical examination and has no further riding engagements this afternoon.
